result.source: MICHELIN Guide primary sources, fetched and parsed from raw HTML on 27 Sept 2026: (1) the Mon Ami restaurant listing https://guide.michelin.com/hr/en/zagreb-region/velika-gorica/restaurant/mon-ami (canonical https://guide.michelin.com/us/en/zagreb-region/velika-gorica/restaurant/mon-ami) — embedded JSON-LD Review object and GTM dataLayer inspected directly; (2) the MICHELIN feature article "Mon Ami, Zagreb County, Croatia: Where tradition meets land and sea" (06 Oct 2025, by Sarah Scaparone) — full body extracted verbatim; (3) the MICHELIN Guide Croatia 2026 unveiling article (ceremony 25 June 2026); (4) the Velika Gorica city listing page. Cross-referenced against the restaurant's own Croatian site monami.hr/o-nama for the Skradin olive oil and house wine (absent from MICHELIN), plus Croatian press and luxurylivingcroatia.com for the multi-year recommendation history. Croatian-language MICHELIN versions of both pages were probed (guide.michelin.com/hr/hr/... and Croatian-slug article URLs) and do not exist — MICHELIN publishes Croatia content in English only.
result.summary:
Mon Ami is listed in the MICHELIN Guide Croatia 2026 at the "MICHELIN Selected" level — the Plate. This is confirmed unambiguously: the page's own meta description reads "Mon Ami – a restaurant in the 2026 MICHELIN Guide Croatia", the embedded JSON-LD review carries datePublished 2026-06-25 (matching the Croatia 2026 ceremony date of 25 June 2026), and the page's analytics dataLayer sets distinction = 'plate', greenstar = 'False', award_type = 'false'. There is NO star and NO Bib Gourmand. Do not claim one. In the 2026 selection of 112 restaurants, Mon Ami is one of the 84 "Selected" entries. Croatian press and the restaurant itself document a run of consecutive MICHELIN recommendations going back to at least 2022, described locally as six consecutive years.

Guide facts: Mediterranean Cuisine, price band €€€ (MICHELIN category "Special occasion"), Trg Kralja Tomislava 26, Velika Gorica 10410, +385 1 6213 333, monami.hr. Open Monday 11:00–16:30, Tuesday–Saturday 11:00–23:00, closed Sunday. Air conditioning, terrace, credit cards. The JSON-LD notes acceptsReservations "No" — a data artefact; the restaurant does take bookings.

The inspector's review is short and names exactly one dish: an "excellent grilled salmon steak accompanied by teriyaki sauce and celery purée." Note the discrepancy worth flagging to the client: the salmon/teriyaki dish named by the inspector does not appear on the restaurant's own published menu copy.

The richer material is MICHELIN's own October 2025 feature article, which is fully quotable. It establishes: opened 1997, still run by the Ceronja family, today led by Bruno Ceronja, son of the founders; chef Goran Marko Beus, 45, Split-born, seventeen years in charge, career along the Dalmatian coast and on ships; sixty seats inside plus twenty on the terrace; oak, marble and stone interior.

Critical gap: MICHELIN never mentions the Skradin olive grove, the gold-medal olive oil, or the house cuvée Chardonnay Graševina. Those come only from the restaurant's own site. Do not attribute them to MICHELIN — attribute them to the restaurant. The dessert MICHELIN calls "Scardona cake" is the Skradinska torta (Scardona is the Italian name for Skradin), which is the closest MICHELIN comes to the Skradin connection.

quotes.text: The steady stream of regulars filling the restaurant attests to the quality of the cuisine, split between seafood and land-based preparations. Fish takes center stage in simple, traditional recipes that highlight the quality of the ingredients. Among the chef's most lauded dishes is an excellent grilled salmon steak accompanied by teriyaki sauce and celery purée. A small, welcoming outdoor area is available during warmer months.

quotes.text: Today, Mon Ami, devoted to a harmonious balance of land and sea, is led by Bruno Ceronja, son of the founders and an accomplished host.

For travelers eager to experience the most authentic side of Croatia, where genuine flavors, heartfelt hospitality, and local traditions come together, Mon Ami is a must-visit destination in Zagreb County.
More than just a restaurant, it's a culinary journey that captures the soul of Zagreb County, offering unforgettable tastes and warm, family-style charm.
The secret lies in the ingredients, a true celebration of the land around us.

quotes.text: Imamo preporuku od Croatia Michelin Restaurants – The Michelin Guide i Trip Advisora, a naša najvažnija preporuka su naši gosti.
Vaše zadovoljstvo nama je na prvom mjestu

verbatimCroatian: Neka Vaša nepca dožive jedinstveni gastronomski užitak mediteranskih specijaliteta u srcu Turopolja.
Kušajte naše delicije poput kvarnerskih škampi, jastoga, školjki, carpaccia od tune s crnim tartufom ili gavuna prženih na maslinovom ulju.
U Mon Amiju vas očekuje dnevno svježa i divlja bijela riba, crni rižoto od sipe, jadranska lignja i hobotnica na salatu, dimljene dagnje.
Uz morska jela možete uživati i u beefsteaku s roštilja u umaku od tartufate i crnog tartufa. Također, nudimo vegetarijanska i jela bez glutena.
Kušajte naše extra djevičansko maslinovo ulje iz vlastitog maslinika u Skradinu, nagrađivano zlatnim medaljama. Shodno tome u ponudi imamo hrvatske zelene masline, te čaj od maslina.
Imamo vinsku kartu od 60 etiketa, poglavito vina hrvatskih proizvođača. Također proizvodimo svoje vino kuće cuvee Chardonnay Graševina iz podregije Pokuplje, vinogorje Vukomeričke gorice.

Nalazimo se u središtu Velike Gorice, ali i u blizini Međunarodne zračne luke Zagreb, tako da u našem ugodnom ambijentu može uživati svatko, od usputnog prolaznika do putnika koji između dva leta želi nešto dobro pojesti.
Organiziramo tematske večere i dane posvećene domaćim sezonskim namirnicama.
Restoran ima 70 sjedećih mjesta. Odvojeni „separe" za 10 osoba namijenjen je poslovnim sastancima zatvorenog tipa.
Interijer je sadržan od prirodnih materijala koji predstavljaju naš pristup življenju i poslovanju.
Vaše zadovoljstvo nama je na prvom mjestu
Mon Ami je idealno mjesto za poslovna druženja, svadbe, pričesti, krizme i krštenja.
Imamo preporuku od Croatia Michelin Restaurants – The Michelin Guide i Trip Advisora, a naša najvažnija preporuka su naši gosti.
Kuhinju vodi chef Goran Marko Beus. Prepustite se našem osoblju koje će vas oduševiti svojom kreativnošću i ljubaznošću.
Restoran uvršten u MICHELIN Guide Croatia 2026 — oznaka MICHELIN Selected.
Michelinovi inspektori ističu da stalan priljev redovitih gostiju koji pune restoran svjedoči o kvaliteti kuhinje, podijeljene između jela s mora i s kopna.
Riba je u središtu pozornosti, pripremljena po jednostavnim, tradicionalnim receptima koji naglašavaju kvalitetu namirnica.

gaps: COPYRIGHT WARNING: every image above is hosted on MICHELIN's CDN and credited to named photographers (Jakob Goldstein, Josip Škof, Mario Žilec). They are NOT licensed for reuse on a commercial restaurant website. Hotlinking or copying them risks a takedown. Ask the restaurant for the original files from the photographers, or commission new photography. Use these only as a visual reference brief.

No Croatian-language MICHELIN text exists. I probed /hr/hr/ locale URLs and Croatian-slug article URLs; both fail, and neither page declares a Croatian hreflang alternate. MICHELIN publishes its Croatia coverage in English only. Any Croatian version of the inspector's review on the website would be YOUR translation, and must not be presented as MICHELIN's own Croatian wording. The two Croatian renderings I supplied in verbatimCroatian are my translations, clearly distinct from the genuine monami.hr copy in the same list.

MICHELIN never mentions the Skradin olive grove or the gold-medal olive oil. That claim comes solely from monami.hr. Do not let website copy imply MICHELIN praised the olive oil. The only adjacent MICHELIN reference is the dessert it calls 'Scardona cake' (Scardona = the Italian name for Skradin).

MICHELIN never mentions the house wine. The cuvée Chardonnay Graševina from Pokuplje / Vukomeričke gorice and the 60-label wine list come only from the restaurant's own site. The MICHELIN article references the region's 'excellent wines' generally but names no producer or label.

The grilled salmon steak with teriyaki sauce and celery purée — the one dish the inspector singles out — does not appear on the restaurant's own published menu copy. Either it is an off-menu or seasonal plate, or the listing is out of date. Confirm with the client before making it a website centrepiece.

I could not determine Mon Ami's exact unbroken list of MICHELIN years. Confirmed: 2022 (Croatian press), 2024 and 2025 (Plate, via an aggregator), and 2026 (verified directly from the guide page). The widely repeated 'six consecutive years' claim originates with the restaurant and local media, not MICHELIN, and I could not verify each intervening year against a primary MICHELIN source. If the site states a number of years, source it to the restaurant rather than to MICHELIN.

MICHELIN's JSON-LD records acceptsReservations: 'No', which contradicts the restaurant's own booking offer and Croatian coverage advising that reservations are recommended. Treat this as a MICHELIN data error and do not reproduce it.
The MICHELIN listing page has only one photograph attached; there is no inspector photo gallery of the dining room or dishes beyond the feature article's six images.
No MICHELIN Green Star and no Special Award: the page explicitly records greenstar = 'False' and award_type = 'false'.

The 2026 ceremony article does not name Mon Ami, so I could not source a MICHELIN quote specifically celebrating its 2026 re-listing. The 2026 status rests on the guide page's own metadata and dataLayer, which is authoritative but not a narrative endorsement.

MICHELIN's stated capacity (about sixty inside, twenty on the terrace) differs from the restaurant's own figure (70 seats plus a 10-person separe). Use the restaurant's numbers for practical information and MICHELIN's only when quoting the article.
